title: Trinity test warning

tellings.quote: Trinity. They said, you know, we don't know what's going to happen. Put on your glasses and keep your head down.

plain: Before the Trinity test of 1945 in New Mexico, the first atomic bomb explosion, the people watching were told that no one knew what would happen. John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, repeats this on the show and ties it to J. Robert Oppenheimer: "we don't know what's going to happen. Put on your glasses and keep your head down." He tells it to show how far into the unknown the scientists themselves were going.
